[t-0831 validator revision: the analysis below is as recorded at the time (pre-fix numbers). Under the fixed validator this run re-scores 85 -> 87 and the 10-13 baseline 94 -> 95: the eval-008 GOTO pair, +2 in both.]
DO NOT READ 94 -> 85 AS A t-0825 REGRESSION. The entire -9 is eval-001 (17 -> 8), and the t-0825 change is hard-scoped to message-like ASSERTs (both _message_outcome_conflict call sites are action==ASSERT gated) - it cannot affect the eval-001 FILL/CLICK picks that collapsed. This run's eval-001 skeleton is a bad LLM draw: it navigates to cart.html directly, resolves 'Checkout' to #react-burger-menu-btn (the burger menu) and 'First Name'/'Last Name'/'Zip Code' to .product_sort_container (a sort dropdown). The deterministic static gate is 91/96 = 94.8% both before and after t-0825. The same-settings band is 89-92/113; 85 sits below it as an outlier low draw. eval-010 c3 did NOT flip to the golden: the t-0825 floor rejected the #order-error trap (it worked), but the journey page-cursor defect (test_04's journey replays 'Place Order' on success.html, picks #back-to-store, and returns to index.html before scraping the success message) left #order-success-title out of scope, so the resolver emitted a degraded full-page :has-text(...) instead. The cursor defect predates t-0825 (2026-10-13 has the same expected_page=index.html on that assert). See docs/sessions/2026-10-15_heldout_remeasure.md.

key_revision_2026_10_28.source: t-1014, the owner's decision of 2026-10-28: a criterion that only says 'go to the page' is satisfied when the browser arrives at that page. Four keys moved from an element to a page-arrival assertion - eval-001 c2 'Navigate to the shopping cart page', eval-001 c4 'Navigate to the checkout page', eval-003 c0 'Navigate to the demoqa.com practice form page', eval-004 c0 'Navigate to the the-internet.herokuapp.com main page' - each keeping its old element as a tolerance selector. This is a definitional correction to the keys, not a tool change: every other 'Navigate to the ... page' criterion in the dataset already held an arrival assertion.
